_note: Pins the generalist review path against unauthorized drift from the specialist layer. baseCommit is the pre-specialist baseline; every later change to a listed function or to the generalist prompt must be recorded here with a reason, so a generalist behaviour change is always a deliberate, documented act.

Write-ReviewerPreview.reason: Seal the configured pass count so an incomplete multi-pass run cannot be promoted as single-pass.
State pinned source coverage in the preview a human reads, and name the changed files whose source never reached the model, so 'no findings' can never be read as 'every file was reviewed'.

Also state what documented convention authority the run consulted. A repository whose config declares no convention packs or authoritative sources cannot raise a convention finding at all, and that gap is invisible unless the artifact names it.

Name partially delivered files too, with their delivered/requested region counts. A file the model saw one region of is not a file it read, and listing only fully omitted files hid that distinction from the human reading the preview.

Route coverage paths through a safe renderer. A pathRejected entry is by definition one that failed normalization, so echoing it into the preview's Markdown let a pull-request author spoof what the human reader sees.

Invoke-ReviewerDelivery.reason: Require code-defined typed delivery authorization before every raw wrapper write.

Get-ReviewerRuntimeContext.reason: Carry the sealed pinned changed-file source block. The host's file-read tool answers with a binary resource payload the model never receives, so without this the generalist reviews files it has not read.

Invoke-ReviewerModelPass.reason: Pass the bound PR's sealed pinned-source block into the runtime context it builds; no other generalist behaviour changes.

Report a marker rejected for wrong PR/repository/commit binding under its own reason, so the pass-level retry can distinguish a formatting slip from a marker bound to the wrong work and never retry the latter.

Refuse an oversized model input as a bounded pass failure instead of throwing. The throw escaped Invoke-ReviewerPullRequest and the cycle's own catch then abandoned every pull request queued behind it, so one unusually large change set ended the cycle for all of them.

Mark that oversized-input refusal an environment fault. The stdin size is deterministic for a commit, so counting it as the pull request's own failure retired the pull request from review after a few identical cycles - permanently and silently, for a wrapper budget the pull request cannot influence.

Invoke-ReviewerPullRequest.reason: Pinned so the source-coverage wiring cannot be dropped silently: this function carries the marker retry loop and the preview call that publishes pinned source coverage and the convention authority summary.

authorizedPromptDeltas.reason: Stop directing the model at the repository file-read tool, which silently returns nothing on this host; point it at the sealed pinned-source block and its binding content accounting instead. Also forbid treating a documented invariant as proof the invariant is enforced.

Require the marker to be one compact line and tell the model to re-check its brackets. A live run lost a complete, correct review to a single stray bracket in several kilobytes of hand-written single-line JSON.
